process.title: Tell us about the garden
process.text: Send photos, rough sizes and what you want the garden to do for you.

process.title: Visit and plan
process.text: We check levels, drainage and access and agree a layout with you.

process.title: Detailed written quotation
process.text: You receive a written quotation covering each part of the garden.

process.title: Build
process.text: Our crew builds the garden, starting with drainage and the sub-base.

faqs.q: Can you do the whole garden in one job?
faqs.a: Yes. We rebuild whole gardens, including drainage, paving, lawn, lighting and garden stores.
Yes, as well as natural lawn. It is chosen as part of the garden layout.

faqs.q: Our garden holds water. Can you fix that?
faqs.a: Drainage is part of every garden rebuild we quote. We look at where water collects and plan the drainage and falls around it.

faqs.q: Do you publish prices for landscaping?
faqs.a: No. Every garden is different, so we prepare a detailed written quotation after a visit. For porcelain patios, see our patios page.

faqs.q: Do you work in my area?
faqs.a: We work within 50 km of Dunshaughlin, Co. Meath. That covers all of Dublin and towns in Meath, Kildare, Louth (such as Drogheda) and north Wicklow.
